**Computation site:** `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which delegates to the markdown service's `ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`; the single-pass version of `ExtractProperties` at line 193). It parses the memo's `Content` as a goldmark markdown AST and walks it, writing the result into `memo.Payload` (`store/memo.go:51`, the `*storepb.MemoPayload` field — derived, not user-set). The API layer surfaces it read-only via `convertMemoPropertyFromStore` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:49`), and it feeds list/preview features like filters (`internal/filter/schema.go`) and user stats (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go`).

**Triggers (recomputation):**
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401`
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`, a batch backfill that rebuilds the payload for all existing memos (100 at a time)

So recomputation happens on every content write (create/update), plus the bulk migration/backfill pass.

**Extracted properties** (from the AST walk in `ExtractAll`, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:376-408`):
- `Tags` — collected from memo-tag nodes (`Payload.Tags`)
- `Property.Title` — text of the first block-level child if it's an H1 heading
- `Property.HasLink` — true if any link node is present
- `Property.HasCode` — true if any code block, fenced code block, or code span is present
- `Property.HasTaskList` — true if any task-checkbox node is present
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — true if any task checkbox is unchecked

(Note: `ExtractAll` also gathers `Mentions`, but `RebuildMemoPayload` only assigns `Tags` and `Property` into the payload — see `runner.go:85-86`.)
